title: Network sensor
description: Zeek and Suricata on shale, reading the mirror of folly's uplink. Logs come from VictoriaLogs, the sensor's own health from Prometheus.

panels.title: Alerts

targets.expr: {namespace="sensor",container="suricata"} | unpack_json | filter event_type:alert | stats count()

panels.description: Alerts in the time range, every severity.

panels.title: High severity

targets.expr: {namespace="sensor",container="suricata"} | unpack_json | filter event_type:alert alert.severity:1 | stats count()

panels.description: Severity 1 alerts in the time range.

targets.expr: {namespace="sensor",container="suricata"} | unpack_json | filter event_type:alert alert.severity:2 | stats count()
{namespace="sensor",container="suricata"} | unpack_json | filter event_type:alert | stats count_uniq(alert.signature)
{namespace="sensor",container="suricata"} | unpack_json | filter event_type:alert | stats count_uniq(src_ip)

panels.title: Events logged

targets.expr: {namespace="sensor",container="suricata"} | unpack_json | stats count()

panels.description: Every EVE record Suricata wrote: flows, protocols, alerts and stats.

panels.title: Alerts by severity

targets.expr: {namespace="sensor",container="suricata"} | unpack_json | filter event_type:alert | stats by (alert.severity) count()

panels.description: Alerts per step by Suricata severity: 1 is high, 3 is informational.

panels.title: Events by type

targets.expr: {namespace="sensor",container="suricata"} | unpack_json | filter NOT event_type:in(alert, stats) | stats by (event_type) count()

panels.description: Protocol records per step, alerts and stats left out.

targets.expr: {namespace="sensor",container="suricata"} | unpack_json | filter event_type:alert | stats by (alert.signature, alert.severity, alert.category) count() as alerts | sort by (alerts desc) | limit 20
{namespace="sensor",container="suricata"} | unpack_json | filter event_type:alert | stats by (src_ip, dest_ip, dest_port, proto) count() as alerts | sort by (alerts desc) | limit 20

panels.title: Latest alerts, severity 1 and 2

targets.expr: {namespace="sensor",container="suricata"} | unpack_json | filter event_type:alert alert.severity:in(1, 2) | format "[sev <alert.severity>] <alert.signature>  <src_ip>:<src_port> -> <dest_ip>:<dest_port> <proto>  (<alert.category>)" as _msg | fields _time, _msg | sort by (_time desc) | limit 200

panels.description: Informational alerts, severity 3, are left out. Expand a line for the full record.

panels.title: Zeek records by log

targets.expr: {namespace="sensor",container="zeek"} | unpack_json | filter NOT _path:in(stats, capture_loss) | stats by (_path) count()

panels.description: Records per step by Zeek log stream.

panels.title: Bytes through the uplink

targets.expr: {namespace="sensor",container="zeek"} | unpack_json | filter _path:conn orig_bytes:* | stats sum(orig_bytes)
{namespace="sensor",container="zeek"} | unpack_json | filter _path:conn resp_bytes:* | stats sum(resp_bytes)

panels.description: Payload bytes of the connections Zeek closed in each step, so a long connection lands when it ends.

targets.expr: {namespace="sensor",container="zeek"} | unpack_json | filter _path:conn orig_bytes:* | stats by (id.orig_h) sum(orig_bytes) as sent, sum(resp_bytes) as received, count() as conns | sort by (sent desc) | limit 20
{namespace="sensor",container="zeek"} | unpack_json | filter _path:conn | stats by (id.resp_h, id.resp_p, service) count() as conns | sort by (conns desc) | limit 20

panels.title: Connection states

targets.expr: {namespace="sensor",container="zeek"} | unpack_json | filter _path:conn | stats by (conn_state) count() as conns | sort by (conns desc) | limit 20

panels.description: SF is a normal close, S0 a SYN with no answer, REJ a refused connection, OTH midstream traffic.

targets.expr: {namespace="sensor",container="zeek"} | unpack_json | filter _path:dns query:* | stats by (query, qtype_name) count() as queries | sort by (queries desc) | limit 20
{namespace="sensor",container="zeek"} | unpack_json | filter _path:ssl server_name:* | stats by (server_name, version) count() as sessions | sort by (sessions desc) | limit 20

panels.title: HTTP requests

targets.expr: {namespace="sensor",container="zeek"} | unpack_json | filter _path:http | stats by (host, method, status_code) count() as requests | sort by (requests desc) | limit 20

panels.description: Plain HTTP only; TLS shows under server names.

panels.title: Zeek notices

targets.expr: {namespace="sensor",container="zeek"} | unpack_json | filter _path:notice | format "<note>  <msg>  src=<src> dst=<dst>" as _msg | fields _time, _msg | sort by (_time desc) | limit 200

panels.description: Zeek's notice framework: scans, weird certificates, capture loss and the like.

panels.title: New hosts and services

targets.expr: {namespace="sensor",container="zeek"} | unpack_json | filter _path:in(known_hosts, known_services, software) | format "<_path>  <host> <port_num> <protocol> <service> <software_type> <name> <unparsed_version>" as _msg | fields _time, _msg | sort by (_time desc) | limit 200

panels.description: Each host, open service and software version the first time Zeek sees it.

panels.title: Zeek capture loss

targets.expr: {namespace="sensor",container="zeek"} | unpack_json | filter _path:capture_loss | stats max(percent_lost)

panels.description: Worst gap share Zeek measured from missing TCP ACKs in the range. Above a few percent the mirror port is saturated or the sensor is behind.

targets.expr: {namespace="sensor",container="zeek"} | unpack_json | filter _path:stats | stats sum(pkts_dropped)
{namespace="sensor",container="suricata"} | unpack_json | filter event_type:stats | stats max(stats.capture.kernel_drops)

panels.title: Log lines shipped

targets.expr: {namespace="sensor"} | stats count()

panels.description: Lines from both pods that reached VictoriaLogs in the range.

targets.expr: sum(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace="sensor"})
sum by (container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="sensor",container=~"zeek|suricata"})
{namespace="sensor",container="zeek"} | unpack_json | filter _path:stats | stats sum(pkts_proc)
{namespace="sensor",container="zeek"} | unpack_json | filter _path:stats | stats sum(pkts_dropped)

panels.title: Sensor CPU

targets.expr: sum by (container) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="sensor",container=~"zeek|suricata"}[5m]))

panels.description: CPU of the two capture containers on shale.
